title: 第五章 说好的退婚呢第六章 不把自己当外人
lines: 张寿终于有些惊了。之前看母亲吴氏那样子，分明是知情却一直隐瞒着自己这个男方当事人，可是连另一个女方当事人都不知道，足可见这婚约实在太坑爹了！
父母之命媒妁之言不假，可你们也好歹给子女早早通个气啊！
他深深叹了一口气，直接枕着双手躺在了茅草堆里：“我从小只知道有娘，根本不知道爹是谁。我还以为终于能知道自己的身世了，没想到还是一场空……唉！”
朱莹此时也正在拼命埋怨心直口快的自己。
虽说今天第一次见张寿，可无论田间偶遇，还是在他家中的这次会面，又或者是刚刚吃过的这顿前所未有的午饭，她都觉得，眼前这个少年不符合自己之前对乡下粗鄙未婚夫的设想。
但他也不似她平日应酬时遇到的那些权贵子弟，不是像炫耀的孔雀，就是像肤浅的白鹅，真要形容他……仿佛像那山林间流淌的明澈清泉！更何况，满京城贵介子弟平日一个个自视那么高，居然就没有一个比张寿生得更好看的！
所以，见他似乎有些颓然，她几乎下意识地开口说道：“你别担心，京城有哪些张姓名人，我都记得！”
“那太好了！”张寿立刻坐起身来，“大小姐能不能指点一二，京城有哪些张姓名人？”
张寿那种诚恳的求教眼神，自然打动了朱莹。她喜笑颜开地挑了挑眉：“你问我就问对了！”
朱莹完全忘了自己挟持张寿，是为了多和他单独说几句话，最好能套出所谓婚约的内情。她竟是认认真真地整理了一下思路，怎么才能对张寿解释清楚。
“京城官场上，最有名的是和我爹齐名的楚国公张瑞。他的二弟襄阳伯张琼，三弟武陵侯张瑁也是战功彪炳的将军。和我爹一样，他们都是跟着睿宗皇帝建功立业的功臣。楚国公快七十了，这次还坐镇宣府，武陵侯更是轮值宿卫。不过，我爹和楚国公关系不大和睦。”
提到如今一战大败被人交相弹劾的父亲，朱莹美艳的脸上流露出一丝黯然：“爹和他从不往来。只不过，我其实也偶遇过楚国公，他为人其实很和善，却不知道为什么和爹合不来。”
听者有意，说者无心，张寿不禁大胆设想了一个可能性。会不会所谓有仇是假的？两个人其实彼此交情很好，明面上却老死不相往来，然后惧内的楚国公还把小妾庶子托付了出去？
朱莹却不知道看似专心致志的张寿其实在专心脑补，又继续往下说。
“然后，是秦国公张川，他爹张允当年是睿宗皇帝的谋士，据说能谋善断，睿宗皇帝帅帐里从来少不了他。他是第二代，武略平平，智谋也只不过一般，对于编书比对于当官兴趣大，睿宗实录就是他编的。”
张寿一面听，一面继续发散思维。嗯，谋士大多担心兔死狗烹，也许是狡兔三窟呢？
“再接着，是怀庆侯张景洲和南阳侯张汉洲兄弟。我爹和楚国公秦国公早先就有指挥使之类的军职，而他们俩是在睿宗皇帝继位之后才从小兵崛起，打北虏，平南蛮之乱，又打倭寇，最终封侯。不过他们一个贪财，一个好色，爹当过他们的上司，每次提起就恨铁不成钢！”
“我爹有一次骂他们，‘知不知道那些御史就和苍蝇一样，一旦有好肉发臭就会立刻群叮上来，更何况你们两块烂肉？睿宗爷爷都不在了，以为还是从前吗？要女人就上窑子，要钱就自己买船下海，再闹下去，老子阉了你张老大，捶死你张老二！’”
说着说着，朱莹为了深入表现父亲赵国公如何待这对兄弟，竟是仿效她父亲的口气，原封不动复述了当初她偷听到的那一番原话。
然而，她那点年纪怎么演得好自己的父亲，更不要说还毫不避讳说出了一个阉字，张寿其实已经忍笑忍得肚子疼，却为了维持好形象，让朱莹能继续往下说，别提忍得多辛苦了。
“功高不忘自省，赵国公果然英明！”
张寿好容易才把那爆笑的冲动按下去，奉送了赵国公一顶高帽子，可眼见朱莹突然神思不属，如今算得上处江湖之远的他不禁生出了一个猜测。
看朱莹两次提到赵国公就神色不对的样子，莫非是她的这位父亲现在情况不妙？
这一次，他竟是忘了再去联想，张家兄弟会不会和自己有什么关系。
但很快，朱莹便恢复了过来，打起精神继续历数朝中那些张姓名人。
“还有定陶伯张谦，他在先帝睿宗皇帝含光初年出使蒙古被扣，而后趁着睿宗皇帝大胜设法逃回，还带回来很多被掳百姓，因为要提倡此等壮举，所以睿宗皇帝封了他伯爵。”
“临汾伯张无熙，治水黄河，巡视各地水利，都是他揽总，再加上最初有那么一点军功，睿宗皇帝很大方，竟然给了他一个伯爵，朝中那时候都要吵翻天了。”
“渭南伯张康，他那名字是睿宗皇帝赐的，其实最初还是投降过来的蛮人，本名已经没人记得了。他打仗勇猛，身先士卒，几次都为了救睿宗皇帝身受重伤……”
“还有都督张信陵……”
“文官里头也有不少姓张的，首先是大学士张钰就是一个，最近还新提拔了一个姓张的翰林学士，名字我一时记不起来了。唔，六部尚书里，户部尚书……”
饶是张寿记性极好，可发现人越来越多，其中还有个挺熟的人名，他不禁渐渐头皮发麻。
content_en:
Zhang Shou was finally a little surprised. Looking at my mother Wu's behavior before, she clearly knew about it but kept hiding it from the male client. However, she didn't even know about the other female client. This shows that this engagement is really a scam!
It is true that parents order matchmakers, but you might as well give your children a break as soon as possible!
He sighed deeply and lay down on the thatch with his hands on his pillow: "Since I was a child, I only knew that I had a mother, and I didn't know who my father was. I thought I would finally know my life experience, but it was all in vain... Alas!"
Zhu Ying was also desperately complaining about her outspoken self.
Although it was the first time she met Zhang Shou today, whether it was the chance encounter in the field, the meeting at his home, or the unprecedented lunch she had just had, she felt that the young man in front of her did not fit in with her previous idea of ​​a vulgar fiancé in the countryside.
But he was not like the rich and powerful children she met when socializing. He was either like a peacock showing off, or like a superficial white goose. To describe him... he seemed like a clear spring flowing in the mountains and forests! What's more, all the noble disciples in the capital think highly of themselves, but none of them is more handsome than Zhang Shousheng!
So, seeing that he seemed a little depressed, she said almost subconsciously: "Don't worry, I remember all the famous people in the capital!"
"That's great!" Zhang Shou immediately sat up, "Miss, can you give me some advice on who is famous for Zhang in the capital?"
Zhang Shou's sincere look for advice naturally moved Zhu Ying. She raised her eyebrows with a smile: "You asked me the right question!"
Zhu Ying completely forgot that she held Zhang Shou hostage in order to have a few more words with him alone, preferably to find out the inside story of the so-called engagement. She actually carefully sorted out her thoughts on how to explain clearly to Zhang Shou.
"In the official circles of the capital, the most famous one is Zhang Rui, the Duke of Chu, who is as famous as my father. His second brother, Xiangyang Bo Zhang Qiong, and third brother, Marquis of Wuling, Zhang Mao, are also generals with outstanding military exploits. Like my father, they all made great achievements with Emperor Ruizong. The Duke of Chu is almost seventy, and he is still in charge of Xuanfu this time, and the Marquis of Wuling is on duty as a guard. However, my father and the Duke of Chu are not on good terms."
Referring to her father, who was defeated in the First World War and was being impeached, Zhu Yingmei's face showed a hint of sadness: "Dad and him have never been in contact. However, I actually met the Duke of Chu by chance. He is actually very kind, but I don't know why I can't get along with my father."
The listener was intentional but the speaker was unintentional. Zhang Shou could not help but boldly imagine a possibility. Could it be that the so-called hatred is false? The two people actually have a good friendship with each other, but they have never been in contact with each other on the surface, and then the henpecked Duke of Chu entrusted his concubine and concubine?
Zhu Ying didn't know that Zhang Shou, who seemed to be concentrating, was actually concentrating on his thoughts and continued talking.
"Then, there is Zhang Chuan, the Duke of Qin. His father, Zhang Yun, was Emperor Ruizong's counselor at that time. It is said that he can make good decisions and is always indispensable in Emperor Ruizhong's command. He is the second generation, with mediocre military skills and average intelligence. He is more interested in compiling books than being an official. It was he who compiled the Records of Ruizhong."
Zhang Shou listened and continued to think. Well, most counselors are worried that the rabbit will die and the dog will be overcooked. Maybe it is a cunning rabbit that has three holes?
"Next, there are brothers Zhang Jingzhou, Marquis of Huaiqing, and Zhang Hanzhou, Marquis of Nanyang. My father and the Duke of Chu, Qin Guogong, had military positions such as commanders earlier, and they both rose from the ranks after Emperor Ruizong succeeded to the throne. They fought against the northern barbarians, quelled the rebellion of the southern barbarians, fought against the Japanese pirates, and finally became marquises. However, one of them is greedy for money, and the other is lustful. Dad was their boss, and they hate iron every time they are mentioned!"
"My father once scolded them, 'Do you know that those censors are just like flies, they will bite you as soon as good meat smells bad, let alone you two pieces of rotten meat? Grandpa Ruizong is no longer here, do you think it is the same as before? If you want women, go to the brothels, if you want money, buy your own boat and go to sea, if you continue to make trouble, I will castrate your boss Zhang, and beat you Zhang Laoer to death!'"
While talking, in order to express in depth how her father Zhao Guogong treated the brothers, Zhu Ying imitated her father's tone and repeated the exact words she overheard.
However, how could she play her father well at that age, let alone say the word castrate without hesitation? Zhang Shou had actually endured the pain in his stomach from laughing, but in order to maintain a good image and allow Zhu Ying to continue talking, not to mention how hard it was to endure it.
"Have great achievements but never forget to examine yourself. Duke Zhao is indeed wise!"
Zhang Shou finally suppressed the hilarious impulse and gave Zhao Guogong a high hat, but when he saw Zhu Ying suddenly lost her mind, he couldn't help but have a guess as he was now far away from the world.
Seeing that Zhu Ying looked wrong when she mentioned Zhao Guogong twice, could it be that her father was in bad shape now?
This time, he actually forgot to think about whether the Zhang brothers had anything to do with him.
But soon, Zhu Ying recovered and continued to count the names of people in the court.
"There is also Dingtao Bo Zhang Qian. He was detained in Mongolia during the early years of Emperor Ruizhong's mission to Mongolia. He then managed to escape while Emperor Ruizhong was victorious and brought back many captive people. Because he wanted to promote such a feat, Emperor Ruizong made him a count."
"Linfen Bo Zhang Wuxi controlled the Yellow River and inspected water conservancy in various places. He was in charge of it. In addition, he had a little military merit at the beginning. Emperor Ruizhong was so generous that he even gave him a count. At that time, there was a huge quarrel in the court."
"Weinan Bo Zhang Kang, his name was given by Emperor Ruizhong. In fact, he was a barbarian who surrendered at first. No one remembers his real name. He fought bravely and took the lead. He was seriously injured several times trying to save Emperor Ruizhong..."
"And Commander Zhang Xinling..."
